1. Introduction
Welcome to FarmForward. By downloading, accessing, or using this mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, please stop using the app immediately.

FarmForward is a crop management system designed to help users monitor farm activities, track crop stages, and estimate yields. The app may require certain user information, including name, email, and location, to provide a personalized and secure experience.

2. Definitions
For clarity in these Terms, the following words have the meanings given:
App — FarmForward mobile application.
User — any person who installs, accesses, or uses the app.
Personal Information — data such as name, email, location, or any identifying information.
Farm Data — crop information such as soil type, planting date, irrigation level, and farm characteristics.
Developers — the team or organization responsible for creating and maintaining FarmForward.

3. Eligibility
To use this app, you must:
\ta. Be at least 13 years old.
\tb. Provide accurate and truthful information.
\tc. Use the app for lawful and appropriate purposes.

4. User Account & Personal Information
Certain features may require users to provide:
\ta. Full name
\tb. Email address
\tc. Location data

You agree to provide accurate and updated information and are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account (if applicable).

5. Permissions Required
FarmForward may request access to:
\ta. Location — to identify your farm\'s region and improve prediction accuracy.
\tb. Storage — to save farm data or profile information.
\tc. Internet Access — for updates or cloud features (if included).

Granting these permissions is necessary for full functionality.

6. Use of the Application
You agree to:
\ta. Use the app only for its intended agricultural and productivity purposes.
\tb. Input accurate farm data for more reliable outputs.
\tc. Refrain from reverse-engineering, hacking, modifying, or disrupting the app.
\td. Not use the app for fraudulent or harmful activities.

7. No Professional Guarantee
FarmForward provides estimates based on general agricultural principles and user-provided data.
The app:
\ta. Does NOT guarantee actual crop yields
\tb. Does NOT replace professional agronomists or agricultural experts
\tc. Should be used as a supplementary decision tool only

8. Intellectual Property
All components of the app—including the name, logo, branding, design, user interface, texts, illustrations, and algorithms—are the exclusive property of the Developers. Users may not reproduce, distribute, modify, sell, or claim ownership of any part of the app.

9. Data Handling & Privacy
Your use of the app is also governed by our Privacy Policy. Personal data and farm data may be collected, processed, and stored locally or in the cloud. Security measures are applied but cannot guarantee absolute safety.

10. Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Developers are not liable for inaccurate predictions, losses, data loss, unauthorized access due to user negligence, or technical issues. You use the app at your own risk.

11. Modifications & Updates
We reserve the right to modify features, update system components, and revise these Terms at any time. Continued use indicates acceptance of updated Terms.

12. Termination of Use
We may suspend or terminate access if these Terms are violated or the app is misused. You may discontinue use at any time by uninstalling the app.

13. Governing Law
These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted according to the laws of the Philippines.

14. Contact Information
For inquiries, concerns, or feedback, please refer to the Contact section of the app.

1. Introduction
FarmForward is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have regarding your information. By using the FarmForward app, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We Collect
We collect two types of data:
a. Personal Information: Information you voluntarily provide or that is required for account setup or app functionality, including:
\t1. Full Name
\t2. Email Address
\t3. Location Information

b. Farm and App Usage Data: Non-personal agricultural and usage data, including:
\t1. Crop type
\t2. Soil type
\t3. Planting date
\t4. Planting density
\t5. Irrigation level
\t6. Farm characteristics

3. How We Use Your Information
a. Personal Data:
\t1. To create and manage your FarmForward profile
\t2. To contact you for account verification, app updates, or support
\t3. To improve location-specific recommendations and estimates
\t4. To secure your account and prevent fraudulent activity

b. Farm Data:
\t1. To calculate yield predictions
\t2. To determine growth stages
\t3. To display farm summaries and insights
\t4. To enhance user experience and app accuracy

c. General Use:
\t1. To improve app performance and fix technical issues
\t2. To provide customer support
\t3. To analyze usage trends for future updates

4. How We Store Your Information
\ta. Personal info (name, email, location) may be stored in the app\'s secure database or cloud service.
\tb. Farm data is stored either locally or in the cloud. If cloud syncing is enabled, your data may be stored in secure hosting services like Firebase, Google Cloud, or equivalent.
\tc. Passwords are never stored in plain text.

5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
\ta. We do NOT sell, rent, or trade personal information.
\tb. We may only share your information when:
\t\t1. Required by law, subpoena, or court order
\t\t2. Necessary to ensure app security or prevent fraud
\t\t3. You give explicit permission (e.g., account transfer or linking services)
\tc. No third-party advertising services are used.

6. Location Data Usage
\ta. Used to identify your farm\'s general region
\tb. Improve accuracy in yield prediction
\tc. Provide environmental or region-based insights (if available)
\td. Location data will not be shared with third parties or used for tracking outside app use.

7. Data Security
We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards, including:
\ta. Encrypted communication
\tb. Secure database handling
\tc. Limited access to personal data within the development team
However, no digital system is 100% secure. Users should secure their device and account.

8. Children\'s Privacy
\ta. FarmForward is not intended for children under 13.
\tb. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If such data is discovered, it will be deleted immediately upon request.

9. Your Rights
You have the right to:
\ta. Access your personal data
\tb. Update or correct your information
\tc. Request deletion of your account and data
\td. Withdraw location permissions anytime through device settings
Note: Some features may not work correctly without location access or profile data.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be reflected by the "Last Updated" date and communicated through app notifications or release notes. Continued use after changes means acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

11. Contact Information
For questions, concerns, or data-related requests, go to the contacts section of the app.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

1. What is FarmForward?
FarmForward is a crop management app that helps farmers monitor crop growth and estimate yield using basic farm information.

2. Do I need an internet connection?
Most features work offline. However, cloud-sync features may require a connection.

3. How do I add a crop?
Go to the Dashboard, tap Add Crop, and enter details like crop type, soil type, and planting date.

4. Why is my predicted yield changing?
Yield predictions update whenever you modify details like soil type, irrigation, or planting density.

5. Why is my stage not updating?
Ensure the planting date is correct. Stages update automatically as days progress based on the crop variety.

6. Who do I contact for help?
Please refer to the Contact Details section in the app.
